title: AL, AR, L and AIR encode distinct directional relation roles rather than one interchangeable slot
summary: Use GDT560's complete state-card geometry to distinguish destination, origin, connection and path roles as separate semantic relation types.

design.mechanism: Each complete relation whole has a stable directional role: destination, origin, connection or path.
design.unit: Complete AL/AR/L/AIR occurrences with independently bound local block position, neighboring OT/OL/DY state and visible target direction.
design.contrast: Distinct-role model versus one interchangeable relation-slot model.
design.prediction: AL, AR, L and AIR retain different successor/predecessor envelopes after state, section and frequency controls; interchangeable-slot model predicts exchangeable envelopes.
design.falsifier: If held occurrences show no role-specific envelope beyond frequency and state position, distinct directional semantics fail.
design.scope: GDT560 cached state cards; independent authorial relation endpoint availability_unknown.
design.related: Near GDT560 and IDEA000? relation-family routes; source observation is not independent lexical meaning.
design.countermodel: A finite state grammar can assign four renderer defaults to one abstract slot and mimic directional envelopes.

design_source_evidence.quote:
# GDT560 — Ausgang, Ziel, Verbindung und Bahn bilden kein Viererfach

Status:
`PASS_EIGHT_RELATION_ENVELOPES__AL_AR_L_SPLIT_GEOMETRY__AIR_ZERO_STATE_SUBSTITUTIONS__67_OF_67_DY_FAMILY_CARDS_CLOSE`

## Ergebnis

Die vier Wörterbucheinträge bleiben klein:

```text
AL   ZIELORT
AR   AUSGANG
L    VERBINDUNG
AIR  BAHN
```

In den1,656 Zustandskarten erscheinen sie216-mal in212 Karten. Jede Stelle hat
eine von8 sichtbaren Kontrollhüllen und eine kurze kompositionelle Lesung.
Anders als `Y/AIIN/AIN/OR` bilden die vier Relationen aber kein gemeinsames,
frei austauschbares Fach.

## Die Geometrie passt zu den kurzen Bedeutungen

| Stamm | Stellen | Blockanfang | Blockende | Handlung rechts | OT/OL links | DY/OL rechts |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `AL=ZIELORT` | 60 | 45 | 39 | 10 | 37 | 25 |
| `AR=AUSGANG` | 58 | 35 | 50 | 2 | 47 | 13 |
| `L=VERBINDUNG` | 92 | 86 | 33 | 58 | 5 | 85 |
| `AIR=BAHN` | 6 | 2 | 3 | 0 | 3 | 3 |
